verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law firm paired with a case-management platform, so user-scheduled recurring workflows or reports are a fair question for its software surface. The evidence describes only case tracking, checklists, deadlines and attorney messaging, with no documented way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Probes found no API or OpenAPI spec that might expose such automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
